description.value: Parachute Ice Cream is a locally owned Victoria institution handcrafting small-batch ice cream from Vancouver Island ingredients, including house-made waffle cones and seasonal rotating flavours. The Bridge Street location is one of three scoop shops across greater Victoria, with pints also available at numerous independent grocers throughout the region. A touring cyclist will find a wide range of options including multiple vegan and gluten-friendly scoops, sorbets, and frozen yogurt.
